using_mode_note: Public Pythonic nested USING, dotted selectors and namespace choices follow ../pythonic-using.md; older nesting, field-selector and constant/call-name rejections below remain for the future strict milestone.
for_control_mode_note: Public Pythonic global-counter calls, read-only counter references and finally cleanup follow ../pythonic-for.md; older fresh-local-only, counter-reference and exceptional-counter observations below remain for the future strict milestone.
string_operation_mode_note: Public Pythonic SUB_STR clipping, zero counts, bounded results and empty INDEX searches follow ../string-operations.md; older substring/search rejections below remain for the future strict milestone.
text_format_mode_note: Public Pythonic dynamic WRITE, quoted fields and scientific conversion follow ../text-formats.md; earlier literal-only, quoted-content and scientific-format rejections below are retained for the future strict milestone.
array_shape_mode_note: Public Pythonic result declarations and first-dimension ARRAY_LEN follow ../array-result-shapes.md; older result-form and multidimensional-length rejections below are retained for the future strict milestone.
evidence: Chosen Pythonic ownership and composition policy, authored regression tests and independent complete example fixtures; no native call ABI claim.
values: Grouped arrays, array fields, named subarrays and ARRAY function results create checked independent writable copies. Bare array storage remains a live caller reference.
copy_contract: Retain concrete dimensions, nominal identities, STRING capacities, narrow element types, joint widths and POSITION protection. Every leaf known, initialized and valid; at most 32767 scalar leaves. No resize, coercion or copy-back.
evaluation: Capture once at the actual argument position in left-to-right evaluation. Later actuals cannot change earlier private copies. Bare forwarding shares the private array; grouping again copies it.
results: ARRAY results compose in grouping, compatible user-routine value arguments, direct RETURN forwarding, ARRAY_LEN returning the first dimension and aggregate access. RETURN still checks and detaches before frame cleanup.
access: Subscripts and fields follow explicit calls or grouped aggregate expressions. Evaluate aggregate once before subscripts. Bare direct receiver names remain storage. Use comma-separated subscripts for nested arrays; chained indexes remain blocked.
failure: Copy validation fails before entering the callee or evaluating later actuals. Errors and ABORT retain earlier effects and unwind frames; private changes never copy back.
boundaries: Named and anonymous fixed/wildcard/mixed result declarations follow ../array-result-shapes.md with exact component identities
Unspecified STRING result capacities and implicit representation/identity coercion remain unsupported
ARRAY arithmetic/Boolean/WRITE use and incompatible types remain blocked; ARRAY_LEN returns the first concrete dimension
Existing conversion argument forms, FOR-counter rules, POSITION protection and explicit robot-context requirements remain
No native controller evaluation, call ABI, persistence or storage acquisition claim; public strict mode is a future milestone
